meta.title: QR
meta.description: Create a QR code in the browser: text, link, Wi-Fi, email, phone, contact or location. Nothing is sent.

header.title: QR
header.tagline: Text, Wi-Fi, contact or location. Nothing leaves this device.

text.lead: A link or a sentence, unchanged.
text.label: Text or link
text.hint: The text is encoded exactly as written.

wifi.lead: A phone joins the network by reading the code.
wifi.hint: The password is written into the image. Sharing the image shares the password. It is not saved.

email.lead: Opens a message ready to send.
email.subject: Subject

phone.lead: A call, or a text message.
phone.hint: A leading + and the country code are recommended. Spaces and dashes are removed.

geo.lead: A place in decimal degrees, opened by the maps app.
geo.label: Place name
geo.hint: From −90 to 90, and −180 to 180. A decimal comma is accepted.

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: Enter something to show the QR code.
preview.label: QR code, {kind}

ecc.label: Error correction
ecc.hint: A higher level survives more damage and holds less data.
ecc.logo: Error correction is H, so the code stays readable under the logo.

margin.label: Margin
margin.hint: 4 modules is the usual quiet zone.

color.warn: Below 3 : 1, some readers can no longer see the code.
color.invalid: Enter a hexadecimal color, for example #1c1a17.

logo.label: Centre logo
logo.hint: An image in the centre. Error correction switches to H. The file stays on this device.
logo.unreadable: This image could not be read.

action.copiedText: This browser cannot copy the image. The contents were copied instead.

error.wifi_password: Enter the password, or choose “No password”.
error.phone: Enter a number with 3 to 15 digits.
error.vcard: Enter at least a name or an organisation.
error.vcard_email: The contact email address is not valid.
error.capacity: This content is too long for a QR code.
error.unexpected: The QR code could not be composed.

scan.lead: Decode a QR code from an image, or from the camera where the browser allows it. Reading stays on this device.
scan.dropHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF. 12 MB maximum.
scan.cameraLabel: Read a QR code with the camera
scan.unsupported: The camera is not available here. An image still works.
scan.none: No QR code was found in this image.
scan.unreadable: This image could not be read.
scan.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

footer.privacy: Nothing is sent. No cookies. No analytics.
footer.credit: Un outil Dynamogic / A Dynamogic tool

app.crash: Something stopped the page. Reload it.
